summary: netdev_hosttest.c and netconf_hosttest.c, the network configuration, with four faults in private copies of rach2/sys/network/driver/netdev.c and netconf.c; the test runs both programs and fails when either fails

argv: set -e; for t in netdev netconf; do if [ $t = netconf ]; then set -- ${SRC}/rach2/sys/network/netconf.c rach2/sys/cmdline.c rach2/sys/lib/kstring.c rach2/sys/lib/kctypes.c; else set --; fi; ${CC:-cc} -std=c99 -D_DEFAULT_SOURCE -D_FORTIFY_SOURCE=0 -DRACH2_HOSTTEST -g -O1 -Wno-empty-body -ffreestanding -fsanitize=address,undefined -fno-sanitize-recover=all -I ${SRC}/rach2/sys -I rach2/sys -I rach2/sys/lib -I rach2/sys/proc -I rach2/sys/network/driver -I rach2/sys/network tests/host/${t}_hosttest.c "$@" -o ${WORK}/${t}_hosttest; done
st=0; for t in netdev netconf; do s=0; ${WORK}/${t}_hosttest || s=$?; [ $st -ne 0 ] || st=$s; done; exit $st

faults.name: refusal
faults.summary: a later driver's error put in place of the first refusal reason

faults.name: tcp
faults.summary: TCP told of a changed local address only for the machine's own card

lines: secondary address change notifies TCP under the network lock

faults.name: primary
faults.summary: the first card's configuration left out of the primary globals

lines: MAC configuration updates all primary globals

faults.name: oversized
faults.summary: an oversized value ending the parse of the options after it

lines: valid MAC option after invalid value is applied
